problem_statement: Activity Log: app banner related to Stats is shown Visit https://wordpress.com/stats/activity/YOURSITESLUG in a mobile device. I was actually able to find this in Chrome's mobile emulator in dev tools: Right now we have nothing in the Redux state that allows us to discriminate this based on `/activity`. As can be seen in https://github.com/Automattic/wp-calypso/blob/master/client/blocks/app-banner/index.jsx#L149 it only looks at `/stats` and this is why this banner is showing. We should have more information about the path being visited so we can exclude it in AL.
